### Your Timeline Is Safe with God
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/your-timeline-is-safe-with-god.html
Passage: Psalm 31:15
Points:
- People often assume they control their schedule, but God is actively directing and guarding their steps.
- Experiencing delays or setbacks does not mean someone has permanently missed out on God's plans.
- God's faithful presence watches over believers during painful trials just as much as in seasons of blessing.
- Believers can surrender anxiety and rest in the assurance that their timeline is secure in God's hands.

### Trusting the Timing of Your Life When Circumstances Suddenly Change
Author: Jessica Ward
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/trusting-the-timing-of-your-life-when-circumstances-suddenly-change.html
Passage: Psalm 31:14-15
Points:
- Abrupt changes and disruptions can easily leave the heart feeling overwhelmed and disoriented.
- True trust is an intentional decision made while circumstances remain uncertain and unresolved.
- Believers can bring raw emotions to the Lord while anchoring their hope in His steadfast character.
- Surrendering our timing to God enables us to choose prayer over panic for each next step.

### Every Second Is a Gift from God
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-oct-12-2008-11582835.html
Passage: Psalm 31:15
Points:
- Next to salvation in Jesus, time is one of the greatest gifts God gives to humanity.
- Human life continues second by second only because God continually sustains it.
- Each person receives the exact same daily allotment of time and is held accountable for how it is used.
- Believers must evaluate their daily walk to ensure they are redeeming their time for God's glory.
